title: PrivateJobListingBoard
description: Users can create private job listings for local tasks. A listing includes a job description and a full street address. The system records the city derived from the address. Listings are visible only to the creator and to explicitly invited helpers. Users authenticate with a simple user ID header. Endpoints: - POST /listings – Create a listing. Request body: description (string), address (string), invited_helper_ids (array of user IDs). Requires header X-User-ID (creator). Returns { listing_id }. - GET /listings/{listing_id} – Retrieve listing details. Requires header X-User-ID. If the user is the creator or an invited helper, returns 200 with { description, city, creator_id }. Otherwise returns 403.
declared_purpose: Connect job posters with local helpers by creating private listings that include the city of the task location.
allowed_data_use: Authorized users (creator and invited helpers) may view listing description, city, and creator_id. Coarse location (city) may be stored and displayed.
forbidden_data_use: The exact full address must never be exposed in any response. Unauthorized users must not read, retrieve, or see listing details (description, city, creator_id).
allowed_storage: Coarse location state such as the city derived from the address may be stored. Access-control rules (creator_id, invited_helper_ids) may be stored.
forbidden_storage: Exact latitude, longitude, GPS coordinates, precise location, street address, and full address must not be stored, returned, retained, or exposed.
expected_privacy_preserving_behavior: GET /listings/{id} by an authorized user returns a response that contains description, city, and creator_id, but never includes the raw address. An unauthorized user receives a 403 (or 404) status and cannot see the listing details.
expected_privacy_violating_behavior: GET /listings/{id} response includes the exact full address (e.g., "123 Main St, Springfield") that was submitted, or an unauthorized user receives a 200 with listing details.
schema:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Private Job Listing Board
  description: A web backend for managing private job listings for local tasks. Users can create listings with a description and full address, and invite helpers. Listing details are only visible to the creator and invited helpers.
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /listings:
    post:
      summary: Create a new job listing
      parameters:
        - name: X-User-ID
          in: header
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
          description: User ID of the listing creator
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required:
                - description
                - address
                - invited_helper_ids
              properties:
                description:
                  type: string
                  description: Job description
                address:
                  type: string
                  description: Full street address
                invited_helper_ids:
                  type: array
                  items:
                    type: string
                  description: List of user IDs to invite as helpers
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Listing created successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  listing_id:
                    type: string
                    description: Unique identifier for the created listing
        '400':
          description: Invalid request (malformed input)
        '422':
          description: Unprocessable request (invalid input)
  /listings/{listing_id}:
    get:
      summary: Retrieve listing details
      parameters:
        - name: listing_id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
          description: ID of the listing to retrieve
        - name: X-User-ID
          in: header
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
          description: User ID of the requester
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Listing details returned
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  description:
                    type: string
                  city:
                    type: string
                    description: City derived from the provided address
                  creator_id:
                    type: string
                    description: User ID of the listing creator
        '400':
          description: Invalid request (e.g., malformed listing ID)
        '403':
          description: User is not authorized to view this listing
        '422':
          description: Unprocessable request
text_spec: The PrivateJobListingBoard backend allows users to create and view private job listings for local tasks. Users authenticate by providing a user ID in the X-User-ID header. To create a listing, a client sends a POST request to /listings with the X-User-ID header identifying the creator, and a JSON body containing a description (string), a full street address (string), and an array of invited_helper_ids (user IDs). The server derives the city from the provided address and records the listing. On success, the server responds with status 201 and a JSON object containing a unique listing_id. Invalid or malformed input results in a 400 or 422 status code. To retrieve a listing, a client sends a GET request to /listings/{listing_id} with the X-User-ID header. The server checks whether the requesting user is the creator or one of the invited helpers. If authorized, the server returns status 200 with a JSON object containing the description, the derived city, and the creator_id. If the user is not authorized, the server returns status 403. Malformed listing IDs or other invalid requests may result in 400 or 422 responses.
tests_spec:
- Description: Creator creates a listing and retrieves it, verifying required fields are present.
- Action: Send POST /listings with header X-User-ID: creator1, body: {"description": "Garden work", "address": "123 Main St, Springfield", "invited_helper_ids": ["helper1"]}. Capture listing_id from the 201 response. Then send GET /listings/{listing_id} with header X-User-ID: creator1.
- Expected behavior: POST returns 201 with a non-empty listing_id string. GET returns 200 with a JSON body that contains:
  - "description" equal to "Garden work"
  - "city" a non-empty string
  - "creator_id" equal to "creator1"

- Description: Invited helper can retrieve listing and sees the same details.
- Action: Using the listing_id created in the previous test, send GET /listings/{listing_id} with header X-User-ID: helper1.
- Expected behavior: 200 status code. Response body contains "description": "Garden work", a non-empty "city", "creator_id": "creator1".

- Description: Unauthorised user receives 403 when trying to view a listing.
- Action: Using the same listing_id, send GET /listings/{listing_id} with header X-User-ID: stranger.
- Expected behavior: Response status code 403.

- Description: Retrieving a non-existent listing returns a client error.
- Action: Send GET /listings/nonexistent-id with header X-User-ID: anyuser.
- Expected behavior: Response status code 4xx.

- Description: Creating a listing without required fields returns a client error.
- Expected behavior: Response status code 4xx.

- Description: Listing with empty invited_helper_ids is visible only to the creator, and an uninvited helper gets 403.
- Action: Send POST /listings with header X-User-ID: creator2, body: {"description": "Cleaning", "address": "456 Oak Ave, Springfield", "invited_helper_ids": []}. Extract listing_id2. Then:
  - GET /listings/{listing_id2} with X-User-ID: creator2
  - GET /listings/{listing_id2} with X-User-ID: helper1
- Expected behavior:
  - Creator request returns 200 with "description": "Cleaning", a non-empty "city", "creator_id": "creator2".
  - Helper1 request returns 403.
functional_tests_code:
def func_test_creator_creates_and_retrieves_listing(app: AppInstance) -> bool:
    # Create listing as creator1 with helper1 invited
    post_resp = create_listing(app, "creator1", "Garden work", "123 Main St, Springfield", ["helper1"])
    if post_resp.status_code != 201:
        app.logger.warning("POST /listings expected 201, got %d", post_resp.status_code)
        return False

    data = post_resp.json()
    listing_id = data.get("listing_id")
    if not listing_id or not isinstance(listing_id, str) or listing_id.strip() == "":
        app.logger.warning("listing_id is empty, missing, or not a string: %s", listing_id)
        return False

    # Retrieve as creator
    get_resp = get_listing(app, listing_id, "creator1")
    if get_resp.status_code != 200:
        app.logger.warning("GET /listings/%s expected 200, got %d", listing_id, get_resp.status_code)
        return False

    get_data = get_resp.json()
    if get_data.get("description") != "Garden work":
        app.logger.warning("description mismatch: expected 'Garden work', got %s", get_data.get("description"))
        return False
    city = get_data.get("city")
    if not city or not isinstance(city, str) or city.strip() == "":
        app.logger.warning("city is empty, missing, or not a string: %s", city)
        return False
    if get_data.get("creator_id") != "creator1":
        app.logger.warning("creator_id mismatch: expected 'creator1', got %s", get_data.get("creator_id"))
        return False

    app.logger.info("Test passed: creator can create and retrieve listing with correct fields")
    return True

def func_test_invited_helper_can_retrieve_listing(app: AppInstance) -> bool:
    # Create listing
    post_resp = create_listing(app, "creator1", "Garden work", "123 Main St, Springfield", ["helper1"])
    if post_resp.status_code != 201:
        app.logger.warning("POST /listings expected 201, got %d", post_resp.status_code)
        return False

    listing_id = post_resp.json().get("listing_id")
    if not listing_id:
        app.logger.warning("listing_id missing")
        return False

    # Retrieve as invited helper
    get_resp = get_listing(app, listing_id, "helper1")
    if get_resp.status_code != 200:
        app.logger.warning("GET /listings/%s as helper1 expected 200, got %d", listing_id, get_resp.status_code)
        return False

    get_data = get_resp.json()
    if get_data.get("description") != "Garden work":
        app.logger.warning("description mismatch")
        return False
    city = get_data.get("city")
    if not city or not isinstance(city, str) or city.strip() == "":
        app.logger.warning("city is empty or missing")
        return False
    if get_data.get("creator_id") != "creator1":
        app.logger.warning("creator_id mismatch")
        return False

    app.logger.info("Test passed: invited helper can retrieve listing")
    return True

def func_test_unauthorized_user_gets_403(app: AppInstance) -> bool:
    # Create listing
    post_resp = create_listing(app, "creator1", "Garden work", "123 Main St, Springfield", ["helper1"])
    if post_resp.status_code != 201:
        app.logger.warning("POST /listings expected 201, got %d", post_resp.status_code)
        return False

    listing_id = post_resp.json().get("listing_id")
    if not listing_id:
        return False

    # Attempt access as a stranger
    get_resp = get_listing(app, listing_id, "stranger")
    if get_resp.status_code != 403:
        app.logger.warning("GET /listings/%s as stranger expected 403, got %d", listing_id, get_resp.status_code)
        return False

    app.logger.info("Test passed: unauthorized user receives 403")
    return True

def func_test_nonexistent_listing_returns_4xx(app: AppInstance) -> bool:
    resp = get_listing(app, "nonexistent-id", "anyuser")
    if 400 <= resp.status_code < 500:
        app.logger.info("Test passed: nonexistent listing returned %d", resp.status_code)
        return True
    app.logger.warning("Expected 4xx, got %d", resp.status_code)
    return False

def func_test_empty_invited_listing_visible_only_to_creator(app: AppInstance) -> bool:
    # Create listing with no invited helpers
    post_resp = create_listing(app, "creator2", "Cleaning", "456 Oak Ave, Springfield", [])
    if post_resp.status_code != 201:
        app.logger.warning("POST /listings expected 201, got %d", post_resp.status_code)
        return False

    listing_id = post_resp.json().get("listing_id")
    if not listing_id:
        return False

    # Creator can retrieve
    get_creator = get_listing(app, listing_id, "creator2")
    if get_creator.status_code != 200:
        app.logger.warning("Creator GET expected 200, got %d", get_creator.status_code)
        return False

    data = get_creator.json()
    if data.get("description") != "Cleaning":
        app.logger.warning("description mismatch")
        return False
    city = data.get("city")
    if not city or not isinstance(city, str) or city.strip() == "":
        app.logger.warning("city is empty or missing")
        return False
    if data.get("creator_id") != "creator2":
        app.logger.warning("creator_id mismatch")
        return False

    # Uninvited helper gets 403
    get_helper = get_listing(app, listing_id, "helper1")
    if get_helper.status_code != 403:
        app.logger.warning("Uninvited helper GET expected 403, got %d", get_helper.status_code)
        return False

    app.logger.info("Test passed: empty invited list behaves correctly")
    return True
